question: What powers were reinstated to the States by the 105th Constitutional Amendment Act?

options.text: Power to identify Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBCs), including Other Backward Classes (OBCs)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Power to identify Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBCs), including Other Backward Classes (OBCs)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 105th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2021, restored the **power of States and Union Territories** to identify and notify Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBCs), including Other Backward Classes (OBCs).
